 Get involved Live Reporting
 Keifer MacDonald
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 42 mins 42 mins 
 Everton 1-0 Newcastle 
 If Newcastle are to find a way back into this match, you feel Harvey Barnes will have a big part to play.
 He has been involved in practically every Newcastle attack so far tonight.
 72 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Cracking finish, but poor from Newcastle to leave Garner that much space.
 Harry 
 138 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It gets a round of applause from Andy Burnham' published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Everton 1-0 Newcastle 
 Izzy Christiansen 
Former England and Man City midfielder on 5 Live 
 It's been coming. It has been coming for Everton, and it gets a round of applause from Andy Burnham.
 The way that James Gardner wraps his foot around this is powerful and clean, and he just shapes it beyond the keeper into the far post.
 If there is one player who Everton want that fall to ball to in that area, it is James Gardner.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 197 220 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 39 mins 39 mins 
 Everton 1-0 Newcastle 
 Harvey Barnes drags his shot wide after the ball falls to him on the half-volley in the area.
 The Newcastle forward really snatched at that one.
 66 58 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Everton 1-0 Newcastle 
 Neil Johnston 
BBC Sport football reporter at Hill Dickinson Stadium 
 Two moments of pure quality - and Everton are ahead.
 At one end James Tarkowski produces a contender for tackle-of-the-season to deny William Osula a certain goal.
 Then, at the other end, James Garner shows great vision to find the bottom corner.
 Everton fans are out of their seats celebrating - including the Prime Minister!
 193 115 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 37 mins 37 mins 
 Everton 1-0 Newcastle 
 Just before James Garner scored, I was writing a post to say that Everton fans' disappointment with Jack Grealish's conduct would only increase if they failed to win this last-16 tie tonight.
 It had been a game low on quality, and then Garner produces a moment of magic!
 167 56 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Everton 1-0 Newcastle published at 20:19 GMT 20:19 GMT 
 James Garner (34 mins) 
 The home side are ahead!
 James Garner opens his account for the season with a stunning, curling effort into the far corner after receiving the ball from Hayden Hackney and driving into the area. 
 You can't say Everton haven't deserved that, they have had the best chances of the match so far.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1283 674 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Even if Barry doesn't score, you can't doubt his effort. He gets properly stuck in.
 Harry 
 306 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:17 GMT 20:17 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Izzy Christiansen 
Former England and Man City midfielder on 5 Live 
 It was an absolute crunching last ditch tackle!
 147 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 29 mins 29 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 What a tackle from James Tarkowski!
 The Everton defender makes a stunning, last-ditch challenge to block William Osula's shot as he races through on goal.
 Osula is down receiving treatment in the aftermath of Tarkowski's tackle. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 255 142 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved - 'Grealish should hang his head in shame' published at 20:14 GMT 20:14 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 As our highest paid player, and knowing that we have a thin squad, Grealish should hang his head in shame if he’s not turned up for training. Disgraceful, selfish behaviour.
 Arlo 
 740 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 There has been a real lack of quality in this game so far.
 After beating Arsenal on Tuesday night, I bet Fleetwood Town are rubbing their hands at the prospect of facing either side.
 185 204 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Hayden Hackney looks as though he is about to roll the ball into an empty net from inside the area after Tyrique George's effort takes a deflection and causes a scramble in the box.
 But once again, Dan Burn is there to hack the ball clear.
 176 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Tyler Dibling - who started the win over Wolves in the last round - wins a corner for Everton.
 However, Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall's delivery is cleared away by Dan Burn.
 122 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:07 GMT 20:07 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Much respect to both sides for putting out full-strength XIs. Giving the competition respect by treating it as something worth winning. Would be great to see either of them do it.
 Steve 
 518 74 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20 mins 20 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Vitaliy Mykolenko picks out an unmarked Hayden Hackney in the penalty area, but the midfielder completely fluffs his lines and fails to make a solid connection with the ball.
 That was easily Everton's best chance of the game so far.
 71 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Everton have 'struggled to score a lot of goals' published at 20:04 GMT 20:04 GMT 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Izzy Christiansen 
Former England and Man City midfielder on 5 Live 
 I think with Thierno Barry scoring three goals in the Premier League this season but they have struggled to score a lot of goals. There is the expectation that Everton are aggressive and front footed in the way they play, but they are very pragmatic under David Moyes.
 Of course the fans want to see more goals.
 99 70 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17 mins 17 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Jordan Pickford is called into action twice in as many minutes.
 First, the England international just about deals with a wide effort from Joe Willock before palming Fabian Schar's long-range strike behind for a corner moments later.
 The resulting corner is eventually cleared by Everton, but Newcastle are growing in confidence.
 154 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14 mins 14 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Newcastle should do better!
 The Magpies catch Everton wide open on the break and, after the ball is squared across the area to Jacob Murphy, it pinballs around the box before Jordan Pickford can pounce on it.
 That was a really good opportunity for Newcastle to punish the home side.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 111 65 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12 mins 12 mins 
 Everton 0-0 Newcastle 
 Newcastle's first real chance of the game falls to Harvey Barnes after a raking pass into the box from Nico Gonzalez.
 The former Leicester City forward's header was well saved by Jordan Pickford.
